newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Shiva started as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Shiva started as neutral.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Therese Murphy said she started coverage of Shiva Corp with a neutral rating.
-- She estimated the company would report earnings of $0.76 per share for 1997 and $1.07 for 1998.
-- While she finds the company's business prospects attractive, Murphy said she believes the stock to be pricey at roughly 48 times earnings.
-- She dismissed recent takoever speculation, noting that possible suitors named in recent press reports faced various obstacles to incorporating Shiva into their businesses.

-- In particular, she said Ascend Communications Inc, mentional as a potential buyer, would be acquiring a similar product line to its own, which would require it to discontinue either its own or Shiva's line.

-- She noted that Cisco Systems Inc, another potential buyer, has spoken of its reluctance to enter into bi-coastal acquisitions. Shiva is based in Bedford, Mass. Cisco is centered in the Silicon Valley area of California.
-- Shiva's relatively large market capitalization is likely to deter suitors such as 3Com Corp and Cabletron Systems Inc, Murphy added.
-- "In the near term, momentum investors are likely to enable the stock to perform in line with the market," she said.
